title: Page 4
content_zh:
但，她不是啊！呃，她确定她不是。
她只是想，几千块真的无法解决她目前的问题，索性狮子大开口向他索讨十万，没想到他还真的给。
她可不会自恋的以为掌尚仁那家伙对她有意思，说不定他早忘了她是哪朵花，或……哪根草。
唯一可以解释的是，他真的很有钱，才不在乎给她十万块。
哼，早知道就多ㄎㄧㄤ一点，这样一来，她就可以如愿的放自己一个长假，一个不会每个月都被房东催缴房租的宁静假期。
是的，她想放假，她找不到自己内心真正的想法，但她明白广告公司的工作，绝对不是她的“真爱”，内心深处似乎潜藏了某种动力，那也许是她渴望去做的事，可她呼叫不出它，思绪混沌不明。
放空，也许是她目前唯一能做的。
手心抵着椅面，低首，无意识地用鞋子蹭着脚边的草，才告诉自己要放空，她又想到掌尚仁。
她巴瑞儿这辈子第一个暗恋的男生……呃，至目前为止，也是唯一一个，就是掌尚仁那个满口甜言蜜语的家伙。
整个小学里，从女校长到女老师、女工友、女同学，甚至窝在学校的流浪母狗，和它的狗女儿们，都曾被他的甜言蜜语“洗礼”过。
“小花，没想到生了六胞胎，你的身材还是这么好。”这是当年他随口称赞流浪母狗的话。
“小小莉，看看你，这么一丁点就长得这么正，等你长大后，一定是狗届的第一名模。”这种鬼话，亏他也说得出口。
“巴瑞儿，你明明是全班最漂亮的女生，可是恰北北得令人很害怕——”这应该不算是在称赞她吧！
“巴瑞儿，看不出来耶，你平常大剌剌的，居然也会刺绣。”
“我妈是全台湾最厉害的裁缝师，只要是和布有关的，她什么都会，做衣服、做包包、刺绣，她全都会！”
突然记起这段对话，脑袋里灵光一闪，她终于知道隐藏在内心深处的是什么了——
那是她们姊妹和母亲共同拥有的美好回忆，如今母亲已不在，它就是一种怀念的象征。
思念，庆念，想念……
原来她想做的事，就是充满爱的动力的工作！
“左金，停车。”

车子在路上行进中，后座的掌尚仁突然出声，担任驾驶的左金将车缓缓停靠路边。
“二少，你要做什么？”回过头，左金一脸纳闷，“今天没其他行程，我们现在可以直接回公司。”
“我想喝杯咖啡再走。”说着，掌尚仁已自行开门下车，走向不远处的一家咖啡店。
停好车，左金尾随进入店里。
二少的行事风格真是随兴，想逛街就逛街，想喝咖啡就马上走进咖啡店，这阵子他总是在冒冷汗，生怕二少的随兴，会让所有早排定的满满行程延宕。
但话说回来，这个二少又喝咖啡、又逛街，明明“额外”穿插了一大堆行程外的琐事，可所有的事，都在他排定的时间里如期完成，真是怪哉！
“发什么呆啊你！”
“没看到有一个甜美可爱的女生，问你要喝什么？”掌尚仁对着女服务生眨眼一笑，女服务生立即回以甜美的笑容。
“喔。二少，你喝什么？”
“不告诉你。”掌尚仁挑眉一笑。“除非你能说出三句赞美她的话。”
“呃，甜美、可爱……的女生。”
没创意的家伙！
唉，算了，给他再修行个八百年，他也说不出花言更别谈巧语了。
“我喝康宝蓝。”掌尚仁阖上Menu。
“那我喝……爱尔兰拿铁。”
点完咖啡，左金讷讷地说：“二少，我先去上个厕所。”
“快滚，小心尿在裤子上。”掌尚仁揶揄。
望着去上厕所的左金背影，掌尚仁突然又想起小六时那个娇小却毒舌到令人退避三舍的风纪股长巴瑞儿。
每当自习课，老师不在教室，他和几个男同学就是待不住，纷纷以上厕所为由，溜出教室，那恰北北兼毒舌派掌门人，总是以“没有真的去上厕所的人，四肢萎缩”的话，吓得他们无论如何都要挤出一泡尿才敢回教室。
低首，莞尔，那女的……他由衷佩服。

“麻烦给我一杯康宝蓝。”后头有个女生如是说。
通常这情况，除非他脖子扭到，否则他一定会回头瞧一瞧，看看哪种女生会和他点同样的咖啡，顺便认识一下，做个朋友，如果她漂亮的话。
不否认，他本人就是外貌协会的会长。
人嘛，第一眼当然是看外表，如果刚认识就对女孩子说我欣赏你的内涵，那才真是见鬼！
想回头之际，却看见左金见鬼似的跑回座。
“遇到色狼了？还是你就是那匹狼？”那一脸惊恐，活像是在洗手间差点被人侵犯了，要不，就是他去侵犯人家，被人拿棍子追打。
看看他身后没人追来，还好，肯定不是他干了坏事，要不，教他这个上司的帅脸往哪儿搁。
“二少，惨了，我忘了一件很重要的事。”
“你刚上厕所，没带卫生纸？该不会要告诉我，你没擦……”恶～臭臭。
“二少——”厚，都什么时候了，二少还拿他寻开心，他都快急死了。
“你不是说今天没其他行程，漏了哪个行程，快点递补，记得先打电话和对方道个歉。”看看腕表，时间还不算晚。“如果对方愿意，等会儿我们就过去，若今天没空理我们，和对方再另约时间喽。”
唉，总裁的日子过得真不轻松，搞得活像艺人在赶通告。
“不是行程的问题……”左金哭丧着脸。
“和行程无关，喔，那应该没我的事。”
女服务生端来咖啡，掌尚仁照例和人家“寒暄”了几句，一派轻松悠闲的模样，和坐在他对面愁眉苦脸的左金，形成强烈的对比。
“二少，怎么办，我忘了买礼物……”
“买礼物？最近有什么节日？情人节？”挖着咖啡上的奶油吃，掌尚仁认真想了想。“情人节已经过了，该送的礼物我也送过了呀。啊，对了，教师节快到
了，难不成你要送教授礼物？天啊，左金，哪个教授有这个荣幸教到你，你都毕业几年了，教师节还不忘送礼物……啧啧，真有心啊你，我替教过你的老师们感到高兴。”
“二少……今天是郭董夫人的生日。”欲哭无泪啊他。
“喔，然后呢？”哪个郭董啊？

“我忘了买礼物……”
“喝完咖啡去挑个礼物，再送过去就行了。”这么简单的事，还不知道该怎么处理，当什么特助啊他！
“可是，大少奶奶说要送手工包……”
“喔？那件事，你到现在还没处理？”他想起来了。
左金惶恐的摇头。
虽然和二少一起工作看似很轻松悠闲，但工作量却未比之前和总裁大人工作时来得少，每天工作其实非常紧凑，忙到他完全忘记这件事。方才上洗手间，听到有个女生在抱怨她男友送她的礼物太小，他才赫然想起这件事。
“很好，左金，你记不记得本人已经将这件事全权交给你处理？所以，是生是死你自己看着办。”掌尚仁眯眼瞪视，出言恐吓。
亏他还直想称赞大哥这个特助真耐用，每天丢给他一大堆事猛操他，他还身强体壮没变弱鸡，重点是，大大小小的事，处理得有条不紊。
没想到称赞的话还未说出口，某金就已经骄傲到忘了处理这件事。
“三少……”
“叫我也没用。”继续爽快的舔奶油。“别怪我没提醒你，我大哥会丢下工作，带着未来大嫂出国，就代表你称呼她为大少奶奶的那个人，现在在我大哥心中是个神——呃，女神，总之，说白点，就是目前在我大哥心目中，她比整个天信集团还重要，而她交代的事你没办妥……不用我说，结果会如何你该知道吧？”
content_en:
But, she is not! Well, she was sure she wasn't.
She just thought that a few thousand dollars really couldn't solve her current problem, so she simply asked him for a hundred thousand dollars, but she didn't expect that he would actually give it to her.
She would not be so narcissistic as to think that Zhang Shangren was interested in her. Maybe he had forgotten which flower she was, or... which grass she was.
The only explanation is that he is really rich and doesn't care about giving her 100,000 yuan.
Hum, if she had known earlier, she would have been more careful. In this way, she could take a long vacation as she wished, a peaceful vacation where the landlord would not have to pay the rent every month.
Yes, she wanted to take a vacation. She couldn't find the true thoughts in her heart, but she understood that working in an advertising agency was definitely not her "true love". There seemed to be some kind of motivation hidden deep in her heart. It might be something she longed to do, but she couldn't call it out, and her thoughts were chaotic and unclear.
Letting go may be the only thing she can do at the moment.
She put her palms against the chair, lowered her head, and unconsciously rubbed her shoes on the grass beside her feet before telling herself to relax. She thought of Zhang Shangren again.
The first boy she had a crush on in her life, Barrier... Well, so far, the only one she had a crush on was that sweet-talking guy named Zhang Shangren.
In the entire elementary school, everyone from the female principal to female teachers, female co-workers, female classmates, and even the stray bitch and her daughters who lived in the school were "baptized" by his sweet words.
"Xiaohua, I didn't expect you to still be in such good shape after giving birth to sextuplets." This was what he casually praised the stray bitch back then.
"Xiao Xiaoli, look at you, you look so upright at all. When you grow up, you will definitely be the number one model in the world of dogs." Fortunately, he could say such nonsense.
"Barry, you are obviously the most beautiful girl in the class, but you are so cute that it's scary -" This shouldn't be considered a compliment to her!
"Barry, I can't tell you that you, who are usually so cool, actually know how to embroider."
"My mother is the most powerful tailor in Taiwan. As long as it's related to cloth, she can do anything. She can make clothes, bags, embroidery, she can do it all!"
Suddenly remembering this conversation, an idea flashed in her head, and she finally knew what was hidden deep in her heart——
It was a beautiful memory shared by their sisters and their mother. Now that their mother is gone, it is a symbol of nostalgia.
Miss, celebrate, miss...
It turns out that what she wants to do is work full of love!
"Zuo Jin, stop the car."
While the car was driving on the road, Zhang Shangren in the back seat suddenly made a voice, and Zuo Jin, who was in charge of driving, slowly stopped the car on the side of the road.
"Second Young Master, what are you going to do?" Looking back, Zuo Jin looked puzzled, "We have no other schedule today. We can go back to the company directly now."
"I want to have a cup of coffee before I leave." With that said, Zhang Shangren opened the door and got out of the car and walked towards a coffee shop not far away.
After parking the car, Zuo Jin followed him into the store.
The second young master's behavior is really casual. If he wants to go shopping, he can go shopping, and if he wants to drink coffee, he can immediately go into a coffee shop. He is always breaking out in a cold sweat, for fear that the second young master's casual style will delay all the busy schedules.
But having said that, this second young master drank coffee and went shopping, and obviously had a lot of "extra" chores interspersed with the schedule, but everything was completed as scheduled within the time he scheduled. How strange!
"Why are you so dazed!"
"I don't see a sweet and lovely girl asking you what you want to drink?" Zhang Shangren winked at the waitress and smiled, and the waitress immediately responded with a sweet smile.
"Oh. Second Young Master, what are you drinking?"
"I won't tell you." Zhang Shangren raised his eyebrows and smiled. "Unless you can say three words of praise for her."
"Uh, sweet, cute... girl."
Uncreative guy!
Alas, forget it, give him another eight hundred years to practice, and he won't be able to speak sweet words, let alone clever words.
"IDrink Herbalife. "Zhang Shangren closed the menu.
“Then I’ll drink…an Irish latte. "
After ordering coffee, Zuo Jin said nonchalantly: "Second Young Master, I'm going to use the toilet first. "
"Get out of here, don't pee on your pants. " Zhang Shangren teased.
Looking at Zuo Jin's back as he went to the toilet, Zhang Shangren suddenly thought of the petite but vicious-tongued Chief of the Discipline Section, Barry'er, when he was in Primary 6.
Whenever the teacher was not in the classroom during the self-study class, he and several male classmates couldn't stay any longer and sneaked out of the classroom on the pretext of going to the bathroom. The leader of the poisonous tongue sect, Qia Beibei, always said, "Those who don't really go to the bathroom will have their limbs atrophied," scaring them so much that they had to squeeze out a pee before they dared to return to the classroom.
He lowered his head and smiled, that woman... he truly admired her.
“Please give me a glass of Herbalife. "A girl behind me said this.
Usually in this situation, unless his neck is twisted, he will definitely look back to see what kind of girl will order the same coffee as him, get to know her by the way, and become friends, if she is beautiful.
There is no denying that he himself is the president of the Appearance Association.
Of course, the first thing you look at is your appearance. If you tell a girl that I admire your inner qualities when you first meet her, that would be really damning!
When he wanted to turn around, he saw Zuo Jin running back to his seat as if he had seen a ghost.
"Meet a pervert? Or are you the wolf? "The look on his face was frightened, as if he was almost assaulted in the bathroom, or else he went to invade someone else's house and was chased with a stick.
Look, no one is chasing him. Fortunately, he must not have done anything bad. Otherwise, teach him where to put his handsome face as a boss.
"Second Young Master, what a tragedy, I forgot something very important. "
"You just went to the toilet and didn't bring toilet paper? Shouldn't you tell me that you didn't wipe it..." Ouch~ Smelly.
"Second Young Master—" Hou, how long has it been and the Second Young Master is still making fun of him, he is almost dying of anxiety.
"Didn't you say that there are no other itineraries today? If you missed any itinerary, hurry up and make up for it. Remember to call and apologize to the other party first. "Look at your watch, it's not too late. "If the other party is willing, we will go there later. If you don't have time to talk to us today, make an appointment with the other party at another time. "
Alas, the life of the CEO is really not easy, and he looks like an artist rushing to make announcements.
"It's not a matter of schedule..." Zuo Jin cried sadly.
"It has nothing to do with the schedule, oh, that should be none of my business. "
The waitress brought the coffee, and Zhang Shangren exchanged a few words with others as usual, with a relaxed and leisurely look, which was in sharp contrast to the frowning Zuo Jin sitting opposite him.
"Second Young Master, what should I do? I forgot to buy a gift..."
"Buying a gift? What festivals are there recently? Valentine's Day? "Digging the cream on the coffee to eat, Zhang Shangren thought about it seriously. "Valentine's Day has passed, and I have already given the gifts that should be given. Ah, by the way, Teacher's Day is coming soon
Yes, is it possible that you want to give the professor a gift? Oh my God, Zuo Jin, which professor has the honor to teach you? You have graduated a few years ago, and you still don’t forget to give a gift on Teachers’ Day... Wow, you are so caring. I am happy for the teachers who have taught you. "
"Second Young Master... today is Mrs. Guo Dong's birthday. "He wants to cry but has no tears.
"Oh, what then? "Which Director Guo?
"I forgot to buy a gift..."
“After drinking coffee, go pick out a gift and send it over. "If you don't know how to deal with such a simple matter, why should he be a special assistant?
"But, the eldest mistress said she wanted to send handmade bags..."
"Oh? You haven't dealt with that matter yet? "He remembered.
Zuo Jin shook his head in fear.
Although working with the Second Young Master seemed very relaxed and leisurely, the workload was no less than when he worked with the CEO before. The daily work was actually very compact, and he was so busy that he completely forgot about it. I went to the bathroom just now and heard a girl complaining that the gift her boyfriend gave her was too small.Then I remembered this incident.
"Very good, Zuo Jin, do you remember that I have given you full authority to handle this matter? Therefore, it is up to you whether you live or die." Zhang Shangren narrowed his eyes and threatened.
Unfortunately, he always wanted to praise his elder brother for how durable his special assistant was. He was given a lot of things to do every day and he was still strong and not weak. The point was, everything big and small was handled in an orderly manner.
Unexpectedly, before the words of praise were uttered, Jin was so proud that he forgot to deal with the matter.
"Third Young Master..."
"There's no point in calling me." He continued to lick the cream happily. "Don't blame me for not reminding you. My eldest brother will leave his job and take his future sister-in-law abroad, which means that the person you call her eldest mistress is now a god in my eldest brother's heart - er, a goddess. In short, to put it bluntly, in my eldest brother's mind, she is more important than the entire Tianxin Group, and you have not done what she told you... Needless to say, you should know what the result will be, right?"
